topics.title: Proposal Organization
topics.description: Organize sections around evaluator priorities and the solicitation's stated needs rather than a generic boilerplate order.

score_labels.pass: Sections are aligned to the scoring logic and buyer priorities.
score_labels.needs_revision: Sections are present but unevenly tied to the buyer's scoring logic.
score_labels.fail: The package reads like generic boilerplate.

topics.title: Strategy and Win Themes
topics.description: Win themes should be differentiating, buyer-relevant, and reinforced throughout the draft.

score_labels.pass: Themes are specific, buyer-facing, and supported by proof.
score_labels.needs_revision: Themes exist but feel generic or lightly supported.
score_labels.fail: The package lacks a coherent strategy.

topics.title: Value Proposition and Discriminators
topics.description: The narrative should convert service features into buyer outcomes, control, and reduced performance risk.

score_labels.pass: Benefits and differentiators are clear and specific.
score_labels.needs_revision: Benefits are implied but not strongly framed.
score_labels.fail: The draft is feature-heavy and outcome-light.

topics.title: Proof Points and Support
topics.description: Claims should be backed by approved references, resumes, certifications, or grounded solicitation facts.

score_labels.pass: Key claims are supported by approved assets or source material.
score_labels.needs_revision: Some claims need stronger supporting proof.

topics.title: Persuasive Writing and Readability
topics.description: The draft should be easy to evaluate, direct, and free from internal process jargon.

score_labels.pass: The writing is buyer-facing and easy to score.
score_labels.needs_revision: The writing is understandable but still generic or process-heavy.
score_labels.fail: The draft is clearly internal or meta.

topics.title: Graphics and Action Captions
topics.description: Where graphics are implied, the draft should identify what visual proof or graphic would strengthen evaluation.

score_labels.pass: Sections note meaningful graphics or proof artifacts when helpful.
score_labels.needs_revision: A few sections would benefit from supporting visuals.
score_labels.fail: The draft misses obvious opportunities for proof visuals.
